main_text.p: expressa; duabus Tabulis, decemque in iis Praeceptis, distincta; ac variis commentariis, deductionibus, explicationibus, applicationibus, Θεσμοῖς conscriptis, aucta; & sic Israelitis tradita fuit. Psal. cIII, 7. Notas fecit vias suas Mosi, posteris Israelis actiones suas. Joh. 1, 17. Lex illa per Mosen data est. Sub eodem quoque scriptionis, distinctionis, ac traditionis modo consideratur, Gal. III, 19. Quid igitur Lex? Transgressionum (planius aperiendarum, hominumque de iis convincendorum) gratia adjecta est, usque quo veniret Semen illa, cui facta est Promissio; Lex, inquam, ordinata per Angelos; (quorum opera & ministerio etiam hic Deo placuit uti: confer Act. VII, 53. Hebr. II, 2.) per manum internuncii (Moses). Et sic frequentissime Legis appellatio νόμος in SS. Literis usurpatur. Ista Israelitarum hoc respectu praerogativa fuit; juxta Ps. CXLVII, 19,20. Deut. IV, 6, 7, 8. Rom. III, 2. IX, 4.

page.notes: Greek words (Θεσμοῖς, νόμος) and the grey-printed passages are set in a lighter, smaller type; some words in the grey passage are partly obscured by a blur and were read with uncertainty. The printed word "Gal." reads "Gal." with a blur near "consideratur". Paragraph mark before II. is an indented line. Printing errors are left as printed.
